# Metztli, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Metztli** works now.

The stories of Metztli place moon at the center of a living mythological world.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Metztli
- **Pantheon:** Nahuatl
- **Domain of influence:** Moon
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 306 of 542

## The Myth at Work

**Origins.** Metztli appears in nahuatl tradition as moon.  The name's meaning, "Moon", shapes the narratives told about this figure. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Metztli in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Solar & Renewable Energy

*Photovoltaics, solar thermal, and the light economy. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Primary seat: Metztli embodies moon — the core of solar energy.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Aviation & Aerospace

*Flight, aerospace engineering, and the sky economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*Resonant seat: Metztli shares symbolic territory with aviation aerospace.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Metztli performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Space, Astronomy & Celestial Science

*Space agencies, astronomy, and the orbital economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*Resonant seat: Metztli shares symbolic territory with space astronomy.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Metztli performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence

*Forecasting, storm tracking, and climate analytics. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Resonant seat: Metztli shares symbolic territory with storm forecasting.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Wind & Atmospheric Energy

*Wind farms, turbines, and atmospheric resource management. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Resonant seat: Metztli shares symbolic territory with wind energy.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

## The Long Employment

Metztli remains a touchstone for understanding nahuatl religion, art, and identity. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in solar & renewable energy, aviation & aerospace, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/metztli/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
